__: dispatch-guard configuration. Copy to ~/.claude/dispatch-guard/config.json and delete whatever you do not want to change. EVERY key is optional; the defaults work in a repository that has never seen this plugin. Keys beginning with _ are documentation and are ignored.
___zh: dispatch-guard 的設定檔。複製到 ~/.claude/dispatch-guard/config.json，不想改的都可以刪掉。每一個鍵都是選用的；在一個從沒裝過這個外掛的儲存庫裡，預設值就能work。開頭是 _ 的鍵是說明文字，程式會忽略。
__scope: That path is the default. --dir <path> overrides it for one command, and $CLAUDE_DISPATCH_DIR overrides it for a whole shell. A project may also carry <repo>/.claude/dispatch-guard.json, which is read AFTER this file and therefore wins - but only for the dispatch.* keys.
__scope_zh: 那個路徑是預設值。--dir <路徑> 可以覆蓋單一次指令，$CLAUDE_DISPATCH_DIR 可以覆蓋整個 shell。專案也可以自己帶一份 <repo>/.claude/dispatch-guard.json，它會在這個檔案之後被讀取、所以會贏 — 但只對 dispatch.* 那些鍵有效。
_thresholds: ======== when to slow down and when to stop ========
_soft_pct_5h: PACE at or above this, on the FIVE-HOUR window. Dispatch is still allowed; the sub-task is told to finish its unit and not expand scope.
_soft_pct_5h_zh: 「五小時」視窗到這個百分比以上就是 PACE。派工還是允許的；子任務會被告知把手上這個單位做完、不要擴大範圍。
_hard_pct_5h: STOP at or above this, on the FIVE-HOUR window. A dispatch is REFUSED. Dispatching a sub-task is the most expensive thing an agent does, so it is the thing worth gating.
_hard_pct_5h_zh: 「五小時」視窗到這個百分比以上就是 STOP，派工會被「拒絕」。派出一個子任務是 agent 做的最貴的一件事，所以那才是值得設閘門的地方。
_soft_pct_7d: PACE at or above this, on the SEVEN-DAY window. ⛔ THE BRAKE USED TO IGNORE THIS WINDOW ENTIRELY: it read the five-hour percentage and nothing else, so an account at 7d 99% beside 5h 0% was told GO and kept dispatching until the SERVER refused. Both numbers were true and the answer was wrong. ⚠ THE 7d PAIR SITS HIGH ON PURPOSE: that window is usually not the constraint, and pacing on it at 70% would throttle a week of work for nothing. ⭐ The stricter of the two windows wins, and the verdict says WHICH one - a reader who sees 5h 0% beside STOP and is not told why concludes the brake is broken.
_soft_pct_7d_zh: 「七天」視窗到這個百分比以上就是 PACE。⛔ 煞車以前「完全忽略」這個視窗：它只看五小時的百分比，所以 7d 99% 配 5h 0% 會被判成 GO，然後一直派工到「伺服器」拒絕為止。兩個數字都是真的，答案是錯的。⚠ 7d 這一對故意設得很高：那個視窗通常不是限制，在 70% 就開始 PACE 會白白拖慢一整週的工作。⭐ 兩個視窗取「比較嚴」的那個，而且判定會講出是「哪一個」—— 看到 5h 0% 旁邊寫著 STOP 又沒被告知原因的人，會認為煞車壞了。
_hard_pct_7d: STOP at or above this, on the SEVEN-DAY window. ⛔ A seven-day STOP is NOT the same instruction as a five-hour one: the resume must be scheduled after the SEVEN-DAY reset, which can be days away, and the verdict text says so. ⚠ A 7d window that resets BEFORE the current 5h window ends is ignored entirely - its percentage is about to become zero, so braking on it would brake on a number on its way out.
_hard_pct_7d_zh: 「七天」視窗到這個百分比以上就是 STOP。⛔ 七天的 STOP 和五小時的 STOP「不是同一個指令」：續跑要排在「七天」的重置之後，而那可能是好幾天以後，判定文字會這樣寫。⚠ 如果 7d 視窗在「目前這個 5h 視窗結束之前」就會重置，它會被完全忽略 —— 它的百分比馬上就要歸零，對它踩煞車等於對一個正在消失的數字踩煞車。
_stale_min: Data older than this is not trusted. Past it the percentage is shown as -- rather than as a number, and the verdict says how old it is.
_stale_min_zh: 資料比這個時間更舊就不信任。超過之後百分比會顯示成 -- 而不是數字，判定也會講出它多舊了。
_burn_window_min: How many minutes back the burn gauge looks. It answers "how fast am I burning NOW", so it reads the recent past rather than the whole window. 0 = the whole window: steady, but over an hour to notice a change. Under 5 is raised to 5 - a shorter baseline cannot resolve a rate from whole-percent readings. DEFAULT 10, and it was 30: readings arrive in WHOLE percent, so one step over a 10-minute baseline is 0.1 %/min against 0.033 at 30 - three times twitchier, and a quiet stretch reads -- rather than a small number. That is the trade, and it is safe for one reason only: NO BURN FIGURE REACHES GO/PACE/STOP.
_burn_x: THE BURN GAUGE'S COLOUR BANDS, as MULTIPLES OF CLOCK SPEED. Clock speed is 100 / window minutes - 0.333 %/min for a five-hour window - and means "at this pace you finish the window exactly as it resets". So 1.00 is "spending as fast as the clock" and 2.25 is "two and a quarter times that". Green below burn_x_yellow; yellow up to burn_x_orange; orange up to burn_x_red; red at or above it. FITTED, NOT PICKED: the owner asked for red 10% / orange 15% / yellow 25% / green 50% of the time, and these are the multiples that produce it - measured over real history they give roughly 49 / 29 / 14 / 7. ⚠ THEY ARE CALIBRATED AGAINST burn_window_min = 10 AND ARE NOT INDEPENDENT OF IT: at 15 or above the RED band is never reached at all, and `install.py --status` says so if you set one. ⚠ Three separate numbers and not one list, deliberately: a list under a known key is silently ignored and you would get the defaults while believing otherwise. They must be positive and ascending; a set that is not prints a line and ALL THREE fall back to the defaults, because a half-honoured set is a calibration nobody chose. To re-fit them against your own history: python Tools/Debug/burn_band_fit.py. For comparison, two sets that were considered and rejected: 1.0/2.0/3.0 gives red only 1% of the time, and 1.0/1.5/2.0 gives red 12%.
_burn_x_zh: 燃燒計量條的「顏色分段」，單位是「時鐘速度的倍數」。時鐘速度 = 100 ÷ 視窗分鐘數 —— 五小時窗是 0.333 %/min —— 意思是「照這個速度剛好在重置那一刻用完」。所以 1.00 就是「跟時鐘一樣快」，2.25 就是「兩倍多一點」。低於 burn_x_yellow 是綠，到 burn_x_orange 之前是黃，到 burn_x_red 之前是橘，之上是紅。⭐ 這些數字是「算出來的，不是挑出來的」：擁有者要求紅 10% / 橘 15% / 黃 25% / 綠 50% 的時間佔比，這組就是能做出那個分布的倍數 —— 用真實歷史實測大約是 49 / 29 / 14 / 7。⚠ 它們是「對著 burn_window_min = 10 校準的，不能跟它分開看」：設到 15 以上，紅色那一段永遠不會出現，而 `install.py --status` 會提醒你。⚠ 刻意用三個獨立數字而不是一個陣列：陣列放在已知的鍵底下會被「安靜忽略」，你會拿到預設值卻以為改到了。三個值必須是正數而且遞增；不是的話會印一行，而且「三個一起」退回預設 —— 半套的設定是誰都沒選過的校準。想用自己的歷史重新校準：python Tools/Debug/burn_band_fit.py。參考：曾經考慮過但沒採用的 1.0/2.0/3.0 只有 1% 的時間會是紅色，1.0/1.5/2.0 則是 12%。
_near_reset_min: Within this long of a reset, thresholds soften by one level, so 95% can read PACE rather than STOP. Deliberate: hitting the cap there costs a pause of a few minutes, not lost work. It is also why a caller must act on the VERDICT WORD and never on the percentage.
_near_reset_min_zh: 距離重置這麼久之內，門檻會軟化一級，所以 95% 可能讀成 PACE 而不是 STOP。這是刻意的：那個時候撞到上限的代價是暫停幾分鐘，不是丟掉工作。這也是為什麼呼叫者一定要看「判定的那個詞」，永遠不要看百分比。
_display: ======== what the status line looks like ========
_colour: Colour the bars. Accepts 'color' as a spelling alias.
_colour_zh: 讓長條圖上色。也接受 'color' 這個拼法。
_colour_warn_pct: The bar and the verdict dot turn ORANGE - the PACE colour - at or above this. Deliberately NOT soft_pct: that decides what is REFUSED, and a person wants a warning colour a little before anything starts being refused. ⚠ BELOW this there is now a fourth state: YELLOW (WARN) whenever the fill has passed the bar's own ┃ time marker - i.e. you are spending faster than the clock. WARN has NO threshold key because it has no threshold: the marker IS the condition. It is colour only and changes nothing the gate does.
_colour_warn_pct_zh: 長條圖和判定圓點在這個百分比以上變成「橘色」，也就是 PACE 的顏色。刻意不等於 soft_pct：那個決定什麼會被「拒絕」，而人會希望在任何東西開始被拒絕之前，就先看到警告顏色。⚠ 在這個門檻「以下」現在多了第四個狀態：只要填滿超過長條圖自己的 ┃ 時間標記（也就是你花得比時鐘快），就是「黃色」的 WARN。WARN 沒有自己的門檻設定值，因為它沒有門檻 —— 那個標記本身就是條件。它只是顏色，不改變閘門做的任何事。
_colour_alarm_pct: The bar and the verdict dot turn RED - the STOP colour - at or above this. Deliberately NOT hard_pct, for the same reason.
_colour_alarm_pct_zh: 長條圖和判定圓點在這個百分比以上變成「紅色」，也就是 STOP 的顏色。理由同上，刻意不等於 hard_pct。
_show_context: Show the context-window bar beside the two usage windows.
_show_context_zh: 在兩個用量時間窗旁邊，一起顯示上下文視窗的長條。
_show_model: Show the model name and effort at the end of the line.
_show_model_zh: 在行尾顯示模型名稱和思考強度。
_show_time_marker: The bar carries a mark where the CLOCK is, so fill ahead of it means burning faster than the window is passing. It reads as a gap until you know what it is, so it can be switched off.
_show_time_marker_zh: 長條上會有一個標記表示「時鐘走到哪裡」，所以填色超過那個標記，代表你燒得比時間窗流逝得更快。在你知道那是什麼之前它看起來像個缺口，所以可以關掉。
_stale_hides_numbers: A percentage that cannot still be true is shown as -- rather than as a number: no data, data older than stale_min, or a window that has already turned over. A figure on screen is read as the CURRENT figure, and under-reading is the dangerous direction - it holds the brake off exactly when it should fire. false shows the old value anyway.
_stale_hides_numbers_zh: 一個「不可能還是真的」的百分比會顯示成 -- 而不是數字：沒有資料、資料比 stale_min 更舊、或者時間窗已經翻過去了。螢幕上的數字會被讀成「現在的數字」，而「少報」是危險的方向 — 它會在煞車最該作用的時候把它鬆開。設 false 會照樣顯示舊值。
_width: Columns available. null auto-detects from $COLUMNS, then the terminal. The line drops its least load-bearing parts from the right until it fits, and NEVER drops the short window - that is the one the brake acts on. An unknown width renders everything rather than guessing narrow.
_width_zh: 可用的欄寬。null 會自動從 $COLUMNS、然後從終端機偵測。這一行會從右邊開始丟掉最不重要的部分直到塞得進去，而且「永遠不會」丟掉短時間窗 — 那是煞車實際依據的那一個。寬度不明的時候會全部畫出來，而不是猜它很窄。
_two_rows: MAY THE DISPLAY SPEND A SECOND ROW when one will not hold everything? Default true, for BOTH the Claude Code statusline and `usage.py --watch`. ⭐ Claude Code renders each line the statusline command prints as its own row - the documentation says so and the shipped binary splits the output on newlines to count them - so one row was this plugin's limitation, not the platform's. ⇒ With it on, the usage windows stay on the first row and the context bar, the note and the model name move to the second instead of being thrown away. ⛔ WHAT IS NEVER MOVED is the short window: it is what the brake acts on, so it stays on the first row at every width. ⚠ false packs one row exactly as before and drops from the right whatever will not fit. A second row costs a row of the terminal above the input box, which on a narrow one is a row of conversation - which is why this is yours to choose. ⚠ Each row is fitted separately; neither can wrap.
_two_rows_zh: 塞不下的時候，可不可以用第二列？預設 true，而且「狀態列」和 `usage.py --watch` 兩邊都適用。⭐ Claude Code 會把狀態列指令印出的「每一行」當成獨立的一列 —— 官方文件是這樣寫的，出貨的執行檔也確實是按換行切開來數列數 —— 所以「只有一列」是這個外掛自己的限制，不是平台的限制。⇒ 打開之後，用量長條留在第一列，Context 長條、說明、模型名移到第二列，而不是被丟掉。⛔ 永遠不會被移走的是「短視窗」：那是煞車實際依據的東西，所以不管多窄它都留在第一列。⚠ 設 false 就跟以前一樣擠成一列，塞不下的從右邊丟掉。第二列會佔掉輸入框上方的一行 —— 在窄終端機上那就是一行對話 —— 所以這個選擇留給你。⚠ 兩列各自裁切，兩列都不會換行。
_show_burn: SHOW THE BURN GAUGE - `Burn ▓▓▓░░░░░░ 1.20% 44m` - THE RATE IS PER MINUTE AND THE UNIT IS NOT PRINTED, because it never changes. Default true. ⭐ IT ANSWERS ONE FORWARD-LOOKING QUESTION: can I keep spending? The bar measures the budget's life against the TIME LEFT IN THE WINDOW, so a full bar means \"this window resets before you run dry\" and half a bar means \"you get halfway\". ⚠ It is a RATIO, not a stock: unlike a health bar it goes back UP when the burn slows, because what it measures is whether the two clocks cross. ⛔ THE BAR AND THE COLOUR ARE TWO INDEPENDENT SIGNALS NOW. The CELLS answer "will the budget outlast this reset?" - full is good, and that is unchanged. The COLOUR answers a different question, "how fast am I burning?", as a multiple of CLOCK SPEED (100 / window minutes = 0.333 %/min for a five-hour window, i.e. the pace that finishes the window exactly as it resets). Green below burn_x_yellow, then burn_x_orange, then burn_x_red. ⚠ SO THE TWO CAN DISAGREE AND BOTH MUST BE READ: a full bar in RED is "burning hard, but the window only just opened and there is room"; a short bar in GREEN is "already crawling, and it still will not last". ⛔ At ZERO cells the colour is forced to red whatever the rate says - the budget is gone in under 5% of the time left, no achievable slowdown changes that, and an empty bar wearing green would say the opposite of the truth. This segment still does NOT use colour_warn_pct / colour_alarm_pct, but no longer because the direction is inverted: those band a usage PERCENTAGE, this bands a RATE. ⛔ UNKNOWABLE IS NEVER DRAWN AS AN EMPTY BAR OR A ZERO. No history (debug.token_usage off), one sample, under five minutes of span, or a flat-or-falling rate all mean the rate cannot be computed - and an empty bar in a column where empty means DANGER would say the opposite of the truth. It renders as ───────── -- instead. ⚠ COST, MEASURED: 2.47 ms per render on real history, against a statusline that draws once per refresh_seconds. It reads at most the last two history files, which history_keep_days bounds.
_show_burn_zh: 顯示燃燒計量條 —— `Burn ▓▓▓░░░░░░ 1.20% 44m` - THE RATE IS PER MINUTE AND THE UNIT IS NOT PRINTED, because it never changes。預設 true。⭐ 它回答一個「往前看」的問題：我還可以繼續燒嗎？長條量的是「預算還能撐多久」相對於「這個視窗還剩多久」，所以滿格的意思是「這個視窗會在你燒乾之前先重置」，半格就是「你只走得到一半」。⚠ 它是一個「比值」，不是存量：跟血條不一樣，慢下來它會「回升」，因為它量的是兩個時鐘會不會交叉。⛔ 現在「格數」和「顏色」是兩個獨立的訊號。格數回答「這個額度撐不撐得到重置」—— 滿格是好事，這一點沒變。顏色回答另一個問題：「我現在燒得多快」，單位是「時鐘速度」的倍數（時鐘速度 = 100 ÷ 視窗分鐘數 = 五小時窗的 0.333 %/min，也就是「剛好在重置那一刻用完」的速度）。低於 burn_x_yellow 是綠，然後 burn_x_orange、burn_x_red。⚠ 所以兩者「會不一致，而且兩個都要讀」：滿格配紅色是「燒很兇，但視窗才剛開，還有本錢」；短格配綠色是「已經在龜速了，但還是撐不到」。⛔ 「零格」的時候顏色一律強制紅色，不管速度多少 —— 那代表額度會在剩餘時間的 5% 之內用完，任何做得到的減速都改變不了結果，而空長條配綠色在「空=危險」的欄位裡說的是跟事實相反的話。這一段仍然「不」使用 colour_warn_pct / colour_alarm_pct，但理由不再是「方向相反」：那兩個切的是「用量百分比」，這裡切的是「速度」。⛔ 「算不出來」絕不畫成空長條或 0。沒有歷史（debug.token_usage 關著）、只有一個樣本、時間跨度不到五分鐘、速率是平的或在下降，四種都代表速率算不出來 —— 而在一個「空 = 危險」的欄位裡把「沒資料」畫成空的，說的是跟事實相反的話。它會顯示成 ───────── -- 。⚠ 成本（實測）：真實歷史下每次渲染 2.47 毫秒，而狀態列每 refresh_seconds 才畫一次。它最多只讀最後兩個歷史檔，而那由 history_keep_days 設上限。
_watch_scroll: usage.py --watch rewrites ONE line by default; a watcher that scrolls fills a panel with history nobody asked for. true keeps every line. Output redirected to a file or a pipe always scrolls - there is no cursor to rewrite.
_watch_scroll_zh: usage.py --watch 預設只重寫「一行」；一個會往下捲的監看程式會用沒人要的歷史塞滿整個面板。設 true 會保留每一行。輸出被導向檔案或管線的時候一定會往下捲 — 那裡沒有游標可以重寫。
_data: ======== where the numbers come from and go ========
_fetch_seconds: How often usage.py may ASK THE API for the numbers. It fetches GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (or $ANTHROPIC_TOKEN), and serves every other call from the cached token_usage.json.
_fetch_seconds_zh: usage.py 多久才可以「問一次 API」。它會用 ~/.claude/.credentials.json（或 $ANTHROPIC_TOKEN）裡的 OAuth token 去打 GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage，其他每一次呼叫都從快取的 token_usage.json 讀。
_fetch_seconds_floor: MINIMUM 120, ENFORCED - a smaller value is clamped UP to 120 and a line is printed saying so. The floor and the default are the same number again. The floor was lowered to 60 on 2026-08-29 to make the claim below MEASURABLE, and the experiment ENDED on 2026-08-31 the way its own stop rule said it must: at fetch_seconds 60 this account drew three HTTP 429s in ten minutes - 08:42:59, 08:47:30, 08:52:01 - so the floor went back to 120. TWO MEASUREMENTS, AND NEITHER ALONE IS THE ANSWER: at 120 s, at least 26 successful calls in 100 minutes with no 429 anywhere; at 60 s, a 429 within minutes. So the cited ~5-calls figure is out by roughly an order of magnitude, but the limit is NOT absent - it sits between those two intervals, it is unknown, and 120 is the interval this plugin has actually seen work. Do not read the 26 successful calls as permission to go faster; that is exactly the reading the 2026-08-31 run refuted. The published figure, kept because it is the only one that exists: about FIVE CALLS PER ACCESS TOKEN (documented by onWatch, https://github.com/onllm-dev/onwatch, whose own default poll is 120 s while it watches ten providers). Below ~120 s the allowance is gone within minutes, every later call returns HTTP 429, and the brake goes BLIND for the rest of the window - during exactly the heavy run it exists to govern, because that run is what burned the calls. claude-code issue #31021 is that outcome, reported and CLOSED AS NOT PLANNED, so no retry recovers from it. And blind means the last good number goes stale and reads LOW, which is the direction that keeps dispatching: too fast a poll does not waste calls, it turns a working brake into one that fails open.
_fetch_seconds_floor_zh: 最小 120，「程式強制」 — 設更小會被「往上拉回 120」，而且會印一行說明。⭐ 下限和預設值又是同一個數字了。下限在 2026-08-29 被調低到 60，只為了一個理由 —— 讓下面那個說法「可以被實測」；而這個實驗在 2026-08-31 照它自己寫好的停止條件「結束了」：fetch_seconds 設 60 的時候，這個帳號十分鐘內收到三次 HTTP 429（08:42:59、08:47:30、08:52:01），所以下限改回 120。⚠ 兩次實測，而且哪一次單獨看都不是答案：120 秒間隔下，100 分鐘內至少 26 次成功呼叫、哪裡都沒有 429；60 秒間隔下，幾分鐘內就 429。⇒ 所以「大約五次」那個數字大概差了一個數量級，但上限「並不是不存在」 —— 它落在這兩個間隔之間、目前不知道是多少，而 120 是這個外掛真的看過會動的間隔。⛔ 不要把「26 次成功」讀成「可以再快一點」，那正是 2026-08-31 那次實測推翻掉的讀法。下面這個公開數字留著，因為它是唯一存在的一個：這支端點每個 access token 大概只能打「五次」（onWatch 記錄的，https://github.com/onllm-dev/onwatch，它自己監控十家供應商、預設也是 120 秒）。低於約 120 秒，額度會在幾分鐘內用完，之後每一次呼叫都回 HTTP 429，而煞車會在剩下的時間窗裡「變瞎」 — 而且剛好是在它最該作用的重載期間，因為那個重載正是把呼叫燒掉的東西。claude-code issue #31021 就是這個結果，被回報之後「以不修結案」，所以沒有任何重試能從裡面恢復。而「變瞎」意味著最後那個好數字會過期並且讀成「偏低」，那正是會讓你繼續派工的方向：問太快不是浪費呼叫，是把一個有效的煞車變成一個會 fail open 的煞車。
_fetch_seconds_jitter: Randomness added to every interval, rolled fresh each time. Default 30, so fetch_seconds 120 means an actual wait of 120-150 s. 0 disables it. Two reasons it exists: it DE-SYNCHRONISES independent processes - several sessions' status lines all tick on the same 60 s refresh and would otherwise drift into lockstep and hit the interval boundary together, which is exactly the burst that spends the call budget - and it spreads load on an endpoint that rate-limits hard instead of delivering it as a spike.
_fetch_seconds_jitter_zh: 加在每一次間隔上的隨機量，每次重新擲。預設 30，所以 fetch_seconds 120 的實際等待是 120～150 秒。設 0 就關掉。存在的兩個理由：它讓各個獨立行程「去同步化」 — 好幾個 session 的狀態列都是同一個 60 秒節拍，不然它們會慢慢對齊、同時撞到同一個間隔邊界，那正是把呼叫額度一次燒掉的情況 — 以及它把負載攤開，而不是變成一根尖峰打在一支會嚴格限流的端點上。
_fetch_seconds_jitter_clamps: ALWAYS ADDED, NEVER SUBTRACTED: a NEGATIVE value is refused and reset to 0 with a line saying so, because subtracting could put the real interval under the FETCH_FLOOR_SECONDS floor (120) - the one thing that floor exists to prevent. And if fetch_seconds plus this exceeds stale_min, a warning is printed but the value is HONOURED: the data would then go stale between fetches, render as -- and read NO-DATA, which is a brake that fails OPEN. Warned rather than clamped, because stale_min may have been raised deliberately and silently overriding a deliberate choice is its own trap.
_fetch_seconds_jitter_clamps_zh: 「永遠是加，絕不是減」：「負數」會被拒絕並重設為 0，還會印一行說明，因為減下去可能讓實際間隔低於 FETCH_FLOOR_SECONDS 的下限（120 秒） — 那正是那個下限存在要防的唯一一件事。而如果 fetch_seconds 加上這個超過 stale_min，會印出警告但「照樣採用」：那樣資料會在兩次撈取之間過期、顯示成 --、然後讀成 NO-DATA，也就是一個會 fail open 的煞車。只警告不夾限，是因為 stale_min 可能是刻意調高的，而安靜地覆蓋一個刻意的選擇是另一種陷阱。
_fetch_gap: usage.py fetches from --statusline and --watch only, NEVER from --verdict. --verdict runs inside the dispatch hook on every dispatch, and a synchronous HTTP call there would stall the dispatch whenever the interval boundary is crossed. CONSEQUENCE: with the VS Code extension and no statusline installed, nothing refreshes and the verdict reads NO-DATA - run `usage.py --watch` in a terminal, which fetches for itself and needs no statusline anywhere.
_fetch_gap_zh: usage.py 只從 --statusline 和 --watch 去撈，「永遠不從 --verdict」。--verdict 是在派工 hook 裡執行的，每次派工都跑，在那裡做同步 HTTP 會在每次跨過間隔邊界的時候讓派工卡住。「後果」：在 VS Code 擴充套件裡、又沒有裝狀態列的時候，沒有任何東西會刷新，判定會讀成 NO-DATA — 這時就在終端機裡跑 `usage.py --watch`，它自己會去撈，不需要任何地方有狀態列。
_token_expiry: usage.py READS the OAuth token's expiry from ~/.claude/.credentials.json and warns 10 minutes before it dies, on the status line and in --watch. It never writes or refreshes that token. An access token lasts about 8 hours and whichever Claude client is running rotates it roughly 5 minutes before expiry, so a warning that appears normally VANISHES ON ITS OWN - one that PERSISTS is the real signal that nothing is running to refresh it. A token already past its expiry is not asked about at all: the request would only return 401, arm the same backoff, and spend one of the five calls to learn what the file already said.
_token_expiry_zh: usage.py 會「讀」~/.claude/.credentials.json 裡 OAuth token 的到期時間，並在它死掉前 10 分鐘警告 — 顯示在狀態列和 --watch 上。它永遠不會去寫或更新那個 token。access token 大約撐 8 小時，而只要有 Claude 客戶端在跑，它會在到期前約 5 分鐘自己輪替，所以出現的警告通常會「自己消失」 — 一個「一直不消失」的警告才是真正的訊號：沒有任何東西在跑會去更新它。一個已經過期的 token 根本不會被拿去問：那個請求只會回 401、啟動同樣的退避、並且花掉五次額度裡的一次，去換一個檔案早就寫著的答案。
_fetch_files: Two files in the state directory belong to this. fetch.log gets one line per FAILED fetch, because a silent instrument is the trap this plugin exists to avoid - a persistent 429 with no record looks exactly like usage that stopped moving. fetch.claim is stamped BEFORE each request and is what makes fetch_seconds real: several processes share one token_usage.json, so two sessions crossing the interval boundary together would otherwise both fetch, and at ~5 calls per token that is most of the budget. It is also the only backoff there is - it is deliberately NOT cleared after a failure, so a 429 is not retried for fetch_seconds. Deleting it forces the next call to fetch.
_fetch_files_zh: 狀態目錄裡有兩個檔案屬於這件事。fetch.log 每一次「失敗」的撈取寫一行，因為「安靜的儀器」正是這個外掛存在要避免的陷阱 — 一個一直不退的 429 如果沒有紀錄，看起來就跟「用量停止移動」一模一樣。fetch.claim 會在「每一次請求之前」蓋章，它是讓 fetch_seconds 真正生效的東西：好幾個行程共用同一個 token_usage.json，兩個 session 同時撞到間隔邊界的話會兩個都去撈，而在大約五次的額度下那是大部分的預算。它同時也是「唯一的退避機制」 — 失敗後「刻意不清掉」，所以一個 429 在 fetch_seconds 之內不會被重試。刪掉它會讓下一次呼叫立刻去撈。
_refresh_seconds: A DIFFERENT interval, easily confused with the one above. This is how often Claude Code RE-RUNS the status line; install.py copies it into Claude Code's own statusLine.refreshInterval, and usage.py never acts on it. Each re-run reads the cache and only reaches the network once fetch_seconds has elapsed, so leaving this at 60 costs no API calls - the display stays responsive while the API is asked at most once every fetch_seconds.
_refresh_seconds_zh: 「另一個」間隔，很容易跟上面那個搞混。這個是 Claude Code 多久「重跑一次狀態列」；install.py 會把它複製到 Claude Code 自己的 statusLine.refreshInterval，而 usage.py 從來不理它。每一次重跑都是讀快取，只有在 fetch_seconds 過去之後才會碰到網路，所以把它留在 60 不會花掉任何 API 呼叫 — 顯示保持靈敏，而 API 最多每 fetch_seconds 被問一次。
_token_usage_file: null means this plugin collects its own into the state directory. Point it at another tool's file to feed the BRAKE from that instead - but only --statusline and --watch fetch anything, so this plugin's own bar, colours and history stay dark unless it owns the status line slot or you leave `usage.py --watch` running.
_token_usage_file_zh: null 表示這個外掛會自己收集到狀態目錄裡。把它指向另一個工具的檔案，可以讓「煞車」吃那邊的資料 — 但只有 --statusline 和 --watch 會撈任何東西，所以除非這個外掛佔到狀態列那個位置、或者你留著一個 `usage.py --watch` 在跑，它自己的長條、顏色和歷史都會是暗的。
_debug: A named block of DIAGNOSTIC switches. TWO EXIST AND THEIR DEFAULTS DIFFER. debug.token_usage is ON by default: it writes one row per reading - how much you had used and when, two percentages, nothing else - to token_usage_history_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.jsonl, MEASURED: 132 bytes a row and about 640 readings a day, so roughly 82 KB A DAY and 2.4 MB over the 30 days history_keep_days holds - and that is a ceiling, because a row is written only when a number actually moved, and it is what makes the burn PROJECTION work. Without it the 'projected to run out before the reset' half of PACE never fires; the soft and hard thresholds are unaffected either way. ⛔ THERE IS ONE NAME AND NO OTHER. This switch has been called keep_history and token_usage_history before now; neither is read any more, so a config still carrying one gets the DEFAULT rather than the value somebody wrote. `install.py --status` names every retired key it finds in your config - that report is the only place an ignored setting ever shows up. debug.API_response_usage is OFF by default. debug.API_response_usage keeps every response the usage API returns, as one JSON array per line - [organizationUuid, accountUuid, ISO-8601 UTC instant of the call, the whole unmodified response body] - appended to <history_dir>/API_response_usage_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.jsonl, on the same LOCAL-midnight rotation as the history files and never trimmed. COST, MEASURED: a whole dumped line is 2006 bytes (the response body alone is 1887), and with fetch_seconds 120 plus fetch_seconds_jitter 30 the mean interval is 135 s - about 640 lines a day, where 720 would be the no-jitter ceiling. So AT MOST ABOUT 1.2-1.4 MB A DAY, and only during a full day of continuous work: while nothing is happening, idle_after_min stops the watcher asking at all. Switch it on to answer a question and switch it back off; do not leave it on for a month by accident. A LIST IS AN ALIAS, so ["API_response_usage"] means the same as {"API_response_usage": true}. It spends NO extra API call - it keeps the response the plugin already fetched - and it writes NOTHING, not even the directory, while it is off. READING THE FILE: position 1 is the per-seat accountUuid and can be null, which does NOT mean 'the same seat as the line above' - it means the line could not be attributed to a seat. There is more than one route to that, so learn the rule rather than a list: IF THE SEAT CANNOT BE CONFIRMED IT IS WRITTEN null - ~/.claude.json unreadable, no oauthAccount or accountUuid in it, its organisation disagreeing with the credentials file (the two are written at different moments and diverge after an account switch), or the token coming from $ANTHROPIC_TOKEN. A null in position 0 means the credentials file carries no organizationUuid, and then position 1 is null too, because there is nothing to confirm it against, so EXCLUDE such a line from statistics rather than averaging it in. Position 0 is the ORGANISATION, which two seats in one team share, so it cannot tell two accounts apart on its own. No email address and no token is ever written.
_debug_zh: 一組「診斷用」的開關。⭐ 有兩個，而且預設值不一樣。debug.token_usage 「預設開啟」：它一次讀數寫一行 —— 當時用了多少、什麼時候，兩個百分比，沒有別的 —— 寫到 token_usage_history_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.jsonl，實測：一行 132 位元組、一天大約 640 次讀數，所以「大約一天 82 KB」，history_keep_days 保留的 30 天合計 2.4 MB —— 而且那是上限，因為只有數字真的動了才會寫一行。而它正是讓「燃燒率推估」能運作的東西。沒有它，PACE 裡「照這個速度到重置前會用完」那一半永遠不會觸發；軟性和硬性門檻則兩種情況都不受影響。⛔ 只有一個名字，沒有別的。這個開關曾經叫 keep_history、也曾經叫 token_usage_history；兩個都不再被讀，所以一份還寫著舊名字的 config 拿到的是【預設值】，不是他寫的那個值。⭐ install.py --status 會把你 config 裡每一個已廢棄的鍵都點名出來 —— 那份報告是【被忽略的設定】唯一會現身的地方。debug.API_response_usage 則「預設關閉」。debug.API_response_usage 會把 usage API 每一次回應都留下來，一行一個 JSON 陣列 — [organizationUuid, accountUuid, 這次呼叫的 ISO-8601 UTC 時點, 整個未經修改的回應本體] — append 到 <history_dir>/API_response_usage_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.jsonl，輪替規則跟歷史檔一樣是「本地午夜」，而且永遠不裁切。⚠ 代價（實測）：一整行是 2006 位元組（回應本體本身 1887），而 fetch_seconds 120 加上 fetch_seconds_jitter 30 之後平均間隔是 135 秒，一天大約 640 行 — 720 是完全沒有 jitter 的上限。所以「最多一天大約 1.2–1.4 MB」，而且要連續工作一整天才會到：閒著的時候 idle_after_min 會讓 watcher 停止要數字。打開它是為了回答一個問題，回答完就該關回去，不要不小心開了一個月。⭐ 陣列是別名，所以 ["API_response_usage"] 跟 {"API_response_usage": true} 意思一樣。⭐ 它不會多花任何一次 API 呼叫 — 它存的是外掛本來已經抽回來的那個回應 — 而且關著的時候什麼都不寫，連那個目錄都不會建。⛔ 讀這個檔的人注意：第 1 個位置是「席位」層級的 accountUuid，它可能是 null，而 null 「不代表跟上一行同一個席位」— 它代表這一行根本無法歸屬到任何席位。造成這件事的路徑不只一兩種，所以記規則不要記清單：「席位確認不了就寫 null」— ~/.claude.json 讀不到、裡面沒有 oauthAccount 或 accountUuid、它的組織 ID 和憑證檔不一致（那兩個檔是在不同時刻被寫的，換帳號之後會不同步），或者 token 來自 $ANTHROPIC_TOKEN。第 0 個位置是 null 則代表憑證檔裡沒有 organizationUuid，那時候第 1 個位置也一定是 null：沒有東西可以拿來對照，所以做統計的時候要「排除」這種行，不要把它平均進去。第 0 個位置是「組織」，同一個團隊裡兩個席位會共用它，所以它自己分不出兩個帳號。⛔ email 和 token 永遠不會被寫進去。
_history_dir: WHICH FOLDER HOLDS THE LOG FILES. Two kinds live there and nothing else: token_usage_history_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.jsonl, a row per reading of how much you had used and when, written when debug.token_usage is on; and API_response_usage_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.jsonl, the whole body of every API response, written when debug.API_response_usage is on. Both roll over at LOCAL midnight, one file per day. null means a logs/ folder under the state directory, which is ~/.claude/dispatch-guard/logs/ - the same place on every platform, with your home folder at the front. TO SEE THE REAL ONE RATHER THAN THE DEFAULT, run install.py --status and read the 'log files' line: it resolves this setting, prints the absolute path, says whether the folder exists yet and how much is in it, and warns you if $CLAUDE_DISPATCH_DIR has moved the hooks somewhere that script does not look. It is a folder of its own because it gets a file a day - loose in the state directory they would bury the two files a person actually edits. No file is ever trimmed, and a whole file is removed once it is older than history_keep_days.
_history_dir_zh: 「log 檔案放在哪個資料夾」。裡面只有兩種檔案：token_usage_history_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.jsonl，一行一筆「當時用了多少、什麼時候」，由 debug.token_usage 開啟；以及 API_response_usage_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.jsonl，每一次 API 回應的完整內容，由 debug.API_response_usage 開啟。兩種都在「本地午夜」換檔，一天一個。null 表示狀態目錄下的 logs/ 資料夾，也就是 ~/.claude/dispatch-guard/logs/ — 每個平台都是這個位置，前面那一段就是你的家目錄。⭐ 想知道「實際」的那個而不是預設值，跑 install.py --status 看 'log files' 那一行：它會解析這個設定、印出絕對路徑、告訴你資料夾建了沒、裡面有多少東西，並且在 $CLAUDE_DISPATCH_DIR 把 hooks 移到別處、而這支程式看不到那裡的時候提出警告。它要獨立一個資料夾，是因為一天就多一個檔案 — 散在狀態目錄裡會把人真正要編輯的那兩個檔案埋掉。單一檔案永遠不會被裁切，整個檔案則會在超過 history_keep_days 之後被刪掉。
_history_keep_days: HOW LONG THE LOG FILES IN history_dir ARE KEPT, in days - both the token-usage history and the API response dump. Default 30. THIS IS THE ONLY SETTING HERE THAT DELETES ANYTHING, so read the next two sentences. Use 0 to keep everything for ever, which is what this plugin did before the key existed. null is NOT for ever - null means 'use the default', exactly as it does for history_dir, so it deletes at 30 days like leaving the key out. WHOLE FILES ONLY, and by age: a day's file is kept entire or removed entire, never trimmed, so a record is never left looking complete when it is not. Age is the file's last-modified time, not the stamp in its name, so it errs towards keeping. ONLY THE TWO NAMES THIS PLUGIN CURRENTLY WRITES ARE TOUCHED - token_usage_history_*.jsonl and API_response_usage_*.jsonl. ⛔ A file under a RETIRED name is left alone however old it is: there is one set of names now, so anything else is a stranger's file as far as this is concerned, and strangers' files are never deleted. Anyone updating across the 0.32.0 rename runs Tools/clean-dispatch-guard.ps1, which removes the whole state directory - because history_dir can be pointed at a folder that holds somebody else's files, and a blanket sweep there would delete data nobody meant to lose. Any value that cannot be read as a positive number - a word, an empty string, true, a negative - means KEEP EVERYTHING rather than 'fall back to 30 and start deleting'. The pruning happens at most once a day per process, at the moment a new day's file is started.
_history_keep_days_zh: 「history_dir 裡的 log 檔案保留幾天」，token_usage_history 和 API_response_usage 兩種都算。預設 30。⛔ 這是這個檔案裡「唯一會刪東西」的設定，所以下面兩句要看完。想永久保留就設 0 —— 那是這個鍵存在之前的行為。⚠ null 不是「永久」：null 的意思是「用預設值」，跟 history_dir 的 null 一樣，所以它會跟「不寫這個鍵」一樣在 30 天時刪。⭐ 只刪「整個檔案」，而且看年齡：一天的檔案要嘛整個留、要嘛整個刪，永遠不會只砍掉前半段 —— 那樣會留下一份「看起來完整、其實不是」的紀錄。年齡看的是檔案的最後修改時間，不是檔名上的時戳，所以它偏向多留。⛔ 只碰這個外掛「目前會寫」的那兩個名字 —— token_usage_history_*.jsonl 和 API_response_usage_*.jsonl。⚠ 用「已廢棄名字」的檔案不管多舊都不會被碰：現在只有一組名字，其他的對這個函式來說就是別人的檔案，而別人的檔案永遠不刪。跨過 0.32.0 那次改名要升級的人，請跑 Tools/clean-dispatch-guard.ps1，它會清掉整個狀態目錄 —— 因為 history_dir 可以指到一個放著別人檔案的資料夾，在那裡做全面清掃會刪掉沒有人打算失去的資料。⚠ 任何讀不成正數的值（一個詞、空字串、true、負數）都代表「全部保留」，而不是「退回 30 天然後開始刪」。清理最多每個 process 一天發生一次，就在新的一天要開檔案的那個時刻。
_resume_zh: ======== 時間窗重開之後怎麼接續 ========

resume._resume_offset_min: How long AFTER the reset to fire. A few minutes of margin, not on the reset itself.
resume._resume_offset_min_zh: 在重置之「後」多久才觸發。留幾分鐘的餘裕，不要正好踩在重置那一刻。
resume._retry_window_min: Keep retrying for this long from the FIRST attempt, then stop for good and leave it to the person. Bounded by TIME rather than by a count, because 'keep trying for two hours' is something a person can reason about while 'three attempts' hides how long that covers. When it does give up it writes a marker the next Claude session reads out loud - a scheduled task has no terminal, so without that a resume that gave up at 03:40 is indistinguishable from one that was never armed.
resume._retry_window_min_zh: 從「第一次」嘗試算起，在這麼長的時間內持續重試，然後就永遠放棄、交給人處理。用「時間」而不是「次數」來設界，因為「持續嘗試兩小時」是人可以推理的，而「三次」會把它涵蓋多久藏起來。真的放棄的時候，它會寫一個標記，讓下一個 Claude session 大聲讀出來 — 排程任務沒有終端機，所以少了那個標記，一個在 03:40 放棄的續跑，跟一個從來沒被安排的續跑長得一模一樣。
resume._retry_every_min: How long to wait between attempts inside that window. Each attempt re-checks whether the window really has reset before running anything.
resume._retry_every_min_zh: 在那個時間窗裡，每次嘗試之間等多久。每一次嘗試都會重新檢查那個時間窗是不是真的重置了，才會去跑任何東西。

_dispatch: ======== the sub-task rules ======== (these keys, and only these, may also be set per project in <repo>/.claude/dispatch-guard.json)
_dispatch_zh: ======== 子任務規則 ======== （只有這些鍵，可以在 <repo>/.claude/dispatch-guard.json 裡按專案設定）

dispatch._task_root: WHERE TASK FOLDERS LIVE, relative to the repository root. Memory/tasks is this plugin's declared default, and the gate CREATES it at SessionStart so an agent never has to choose a location - it makes its <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-task-name>/ folder inside one that already exists. Change it to put task files elsewhere; a relative path is resolved against the repository root, so an absolute path is not what you want here.
dispatch._task_root_null: null means AUTO: the first of Memory/tasks, .agent-tasks or tasks that already exists in the repository, else Memory/tasks. That is the code default, so the shipped file must not pin a value - pinning one would silently move a repository that already keeps task folders somewhere else.
dispatch._task_root_null_zh: null 代表「自動」：用 repository 裡已經存在的 Memory/tasks、.agent-tasks 或 tasks，都沒有就用 Memory/tasks。⛔ 那是程式的預設值，所以出貨的檔案不能寫死一個值 —— 寫死會把本來就用別的位置的專案悄悄搬走。
dispatch._task_root_zh: 「任務資料夾放在哪裡」，相對於儲存庫根目錄。Memory/tasks 是這個外掛「宣告的預設值」，而 gate 會在 SessionStart「建立」它，所以 agent 永遠不需要自己挑位置 — 它只要在一個已經存在的資料夾裡面，建自己的 <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-任務名>/ 就好。想把任務檔案放到別的地方就改這個值；相對路徑會以儲存庫根目錄為基準解析，所以這裡不要填絕對路徑。
dispatch._task_root_null: null instead of a path falls back to COMPATIBILITY DETECTION: the first of Memory/tasks, .agent-tasks, tasks that already exists is used, and Memory/tasks is created when none of them does. That exists so a repository already keeping task folders under one of the other two is not forced into a second convention. A new repository should just leave the value below.
dispatch._task_root_null_zh: 填 null 而不是路徑，會退回「相容偵測」：Memory/tasks、.agent-tasks、tasks 裡面「第一個已經存在的」會被採用，三個都不存在時則建立 Memory/tasks。這個機制存在，是為了讓一個本來就把任務資料夾放在另外兩個名字底下的儲存庫，不會被迫多出第二套慣例。新的儲存庫就直接留著下面這個值。
dispatch._plan_glob: What a dispatch plan is called inside a task folder. A dispatch with no matching file written in this session is refused.
dispatch._plan_glob_zh: 在任務資料夾裡，派工計畫叫什麼名字。這個 session 沒有寫過相符檔案的派工會被拒絕。
dispatch._approval_glob: The artefact that records an owner's approval of concurrency. It must state the count as 'parallel N', 'N=<n>' or '平行N' - a bare integer is NOT accepted, because records conventionally start with a date and '2026-08-26' would parse as a count of 2026.
dispatch._approval_glob_zh: 記錄 owner 核准同時執行的那個檔案。它必須用 'parallel N'、'N=<n>' 或 '平行N' 寫出數量 — 「單純一個整數不被接受」，因為紀錄習慣上會用日期開頭，而 '2026-08-26' 會被解析成 2026 這個數量。
dispatch._approval_ttl_min: An approval expires. Left lying in a task folder it would otherwise silently grant concurrency to every later session that touched it. Nothing can stop an agent WRITING one - what this buys is that the act is deliberate, that it expires, and that its use is one log line.
dispatch._approval_ttl_min_zh: 核准會過期。被留在任務資料夾裡的話，它會安靜地把同時執行的權限發給後來每一個碰到它的 session。沒有任何東西能阻止 agent「自己寫」一份 — 這個機制買到的是：那個動作是刻意的、它會過期、而且它的使用會留下一行 log。
dispatch._protocol_doc: Named in refusal messages and in the line printed at session start, so an agent that has been refused knows where to read.
dispatch._protocol_doc_zh: 會出現在拒絕訊息裡、以及每個 session 開場那一行裡，所以一個被拒絕的 agent 知道去哪裡讀。
dispatch._max_slots: Ceiling on an approved concurrency count, however large a number the approval names.
dispatch._max_slots_zh: 已核准的同時執行數量的上限，不管那份核准寫了多大的數字。
dispatch._slot_ttl_min: A slot older than this is assumed abandoned. A dispatch that dies without its PostToolUse - an interrupt, an API error, a killed process - would otherwise hold its slot forever and every later dispatch would be refused, which reads exactly like the rule working.
dispatch._slot_ttl_min_zh: 比這個更舊的佔位會被視為已放棄。一個死在 PostToolUse 之前的派工 — 被中斷、API 錯誤、行程被殺 — 否則會永遠佔著那個位子，而之後每一個派工都會被拒絕，「那看起來跟規則正常運作一模一樣」。
dispatch._brake_on_usage: Refuse a dispatch when the verdict is STOP.
dispatch._brake_on_usage_zh: 判定是 STOP 的時候拒絕派工。
dispatch._warn_on_usage: Attach a hold-your-scope note to the sub-task's prompt when the verdict is PACE.
dispatch._warn_on_usage_zh: 判定是 PACE 的時候，在子任務的提示上附一句「守住範圍」的提醒。
dispatch._auto_vscode_task: ON by default: the SessionStart hook writes this project's `Claude Usage Watcher` task into .vscode/tasks.json when it is missing, and repairs it when it points at an older version. It REFUSES on a conflict rather than overwriting: never when that file is tracked by git (the task holds an absolute path with this machine's plugin version in it, and committing that hands the next person a broken task), and never when the file exists but cannot be parsed - VS Code allows comments there and this reader does not. It says what it did, every time. Set false to keep it out of your projects; the usage brake does not need it, since the gate keeps its own clock.
dispatch._auto_vscode_task_zh: 預設開啟：SessionStart hook 會在這個專案缺少 `Claude Usage Watcher` 工作時把它寫進 .vscode/tasks.json，指向舊版本時則修好它。⛔ 遇到衝突是「拒絕」而不是覆蓋：.vscode/tasks.json 被 git 追蹤時絕不寫（那裡面是這台機器的絕對路徑還帶版本號，commit 出去等於給下一個人一個壞掉的工作），檔案存在但解析不了時也絕不寫（VS Code 允許註解，這個讀取器不允許）。它每次都會說它做了什麼。設成 false 就完全不碰你的專案；⭐ 用量煎車不需要它，gate 自己有時鐘。
dispatch._auto_statusline: ON by default. When NOTHING owns the statusLine slot, the SessionStart hook installs the usage line into it, so the CLI shows the numbers with no command typed. An occupied slot is never touched, whoever owns it - taking one over stays behind --take-statusline. Set false to keep an empty slot empty.
dispatch._auto_statusline_zh: 預設開啟。狀態列那個位置沒有人佔的時候，SessionStart hook 會把用量那一行裝進去，於是 CLI 不用敲任何指令就看得到數字。⛔ 已經有人佔著就絕對不碰，不管是誰佔的 —— 要搶那個位置仍然只能用 --take-statusline。設成 false 就讓空的位置保持空的。
dispatch._max_model_price: The MOST a sub-agent's model may cost, in US dollars per million INPUT tokens. Default 5: that allows haiku, sonnet and the current opus, and refuses fable, mythos and the retired opus 4/4.1. null or 0 switches the check off. ⭐ WHERE THE TABLE IS: `model_pricing.json`, parsed from Anthropic's published pricing page (see `model_price_url`) by hooks/model_pricing.py. Read it with `model_pricing.py --show`. ⛔ IT IS NOT TYPED INTO ANY SOURCE FILE ANY MORE, and that is the point: the old hand-copied table overcharged Claude Haiku 3.5 against the published price and nothing said so. The skill and the sub-task prompt now carry the RULE and get the NUMBERS interpolated at run time, and a check asserts no price literal has crept back into either. ⛔ A NUMBER RATHER THAN A MODEL NAME, because a name goes stale while a number does not: `opus` meant $15 in 2025 and means $5 now, so a limit written as a name silently changes what it permits when a family is repriced - the one thing a cost limit must never do. A model name IS still accepted and priced, because it is what a hand reaches for. ⚠ Omitting `model` is always allowed - the sub-agent inherits the model you chose - so this can never deadlock a session. A mistyped limit fails OPEN and is logged (MODEL-PRICE-LIMIT-UNKNOWN); an unreadable table fails OPEN and is logged (MODEL-PRICE-TABLE-MISSING); and `availableModels` narrows it further (MODEL-PRICE-LIMIT-CLAMPED).
dispatch._max_model_price_zh: 「子代理」的模型最多可以花多少錢：每百萬「輸入」token 的美元。預設 5：這會放行 haiku、sonnet、以及目前的 opus，並且拒絕 fable、mythos、還有已退役的 opus 4/4.1。設 null 或 0 就關掉這個檢查。⭐ 對照表在哪裡：`model_pricing.json`，由 hooks/model_pricing.py 從 Anthropic 官方定價頁（見 `model_price_url`）解析而來。用 `model_pricing.py --show` 可以看。⛔ 它已經不再被手打在任何原始碼裡，而這正是重點：舊的那張手抄表把 Claude Haiku 3.5 標得比公告價貴，而且沒有任何東西會說。skill 和子任務提示詞現在只帶「規則」，「數字」在執行時才帶入，而且有一項檢查斷言兩邊都沒有再出現價格字面值。⛔ 為什麼用「數字」而不是「模型名稱」：名稱會過期，數字不會。`opus` 在 2025 年的意思是 $15，現在的意思是 $5 —— 所以一個用名稱寫的上限，會在某個家族被重新定價的時候「安靜地改變它允許什麼」。⭐ 模型名稱「仍然」會被接受並換算成價格。⚠ 不寫 `model` 永遠放行 —— 子代理會繼承你選的模型 —— 所以這條規則不可能鎖死 session。⚠ 上限打錯字會 fail open 並記一行 log（MODEL-PRICE-LIMIT-UNKNOWN）；讀不到價格表也會 fail open 並記 log（MODEL-PRICE-TABLE-MISSING）；而 `availableModels` 會再把它收窄（MODEL-PRICE-LIMIT-CLAMPED）。
dispatch._require_handoff_past_soft: PAST THE SOFT THRESHOLD, A DISPATCH NEEDS A CURRENT HANDOFF ON DISK. Default true. ⛔ WHY: the handoff used to be written when the agent hit STOP, which assumes it still gets a turn - and a real cut-off, the server refusing, gives no turn at all. Then the resume wakes with nothing on disk saying what was being done. ⇒ The file has to exist BEFORE the interruption, and the room between soft and hard is exactly where it can be written. ⭐ WHAT true DOES: once `usage.py --verdict` reads PACE or STOP, a dispatch is REFUSED unless <task folder>/HANDOFF.md exists, is at least 200 characters of content, and is NEWER THAN THIS SESSION. Those three are reported separately - missing, placeholder, stale - because the remedies differ: write one, put substance in it, refresh it. ⚠ It gates DISPATCH only. Your own work is never blocked, and writing the file is one tool call. Below the soft threshold it never fires. ⛔ WHAT false DOES, AND IT CHANGES TWO THINGS. (1) The dispatch is allowed without a handoff. (2) `resume.py --arm` stops refusing without one, and the resume then wakes with a RECONSTRUCTION prompt instead of a handoff: it is told to rebuild the state from progress.md first, then git, then the task folder, never from the session transcript, and never to redo work that is already committed - and to write the handoff as its FIRST action so the next cut-off is not identical. ⚠ That reconstruction costs a chunk of the new window, which is what you are trading away. ⭐ THE DEFAULT IS true BECAUSE THE TWO FAILURES ARE NOT SYMMETRIC: refusing is LOUD and costs one file write, while not refusing is SILENT and costs a whole window. ⚠ WHEN YOU WILL ACTUALLY SEE THIS REFUSAL: at PACE. With `brake_on_usage` at its default, a dispatch at STOP is already refused EARLIER by the usage brake, which returns before this check runs - so the STOP half of the condition is only reachable with `brake_on_usage: false`. ⇒ A document describing what a reader MEETS is right to say \"from PACE onward\"; this comment describes what the CODE tests, which has to cover both. They are two different statements, not two copies of one.
dispatch._require_handoff_past_soft_zh: 越過 soft 門檻之後，派工需要硬碟上有一份「當前的」handoff。預設 true。⛔ 為什麼：handoff 以前是「撞到 STOP 才寫」，那假設 agent 還有一個回合可以寫 —— 而真正的強制中斷（伺服器直接拒絕）根本不給那個回合。然後 resume 醒來，硬碟上沒有任何東西說明剛才在做什麼。⇒ 這個檔案必須在「中斷之前」就存在，而 soft 到 hard 之間那段，正是寫它的空間。⭐ true 會做什麼：一旦 `usage.py --verdict` 讀到 PACE 或 STOP，派工就會被「拒絕」，除非 <任務資料夾>/HANDOFF.md 存在、內容至少 200 字元、而且「比這個 session 還新」。這三種情況會分開回報 —— 沒有、只是佔位、過期 —— 因為補救方式不同：寫一份、寫進實質內容、更新它。⚠ 它只擋「派工」。你自己做事永遠不會被擋，而寫那個檔只要一次工具呼叫。在 soft 門檻以下它永遠不會觸發。⛔ false 會做什麼，而且它改變「兩件」事：（1）沒有 handoff 也可以派工。（2）`resume.py --arm` 不再因為沒有 handoff 而拒絕，而 resume 醒來時拿到的是一份「重建」提示詞而不是 handoff：它會被告知先讀 progress.md、再讀 git、再讀任務資料夾，「永遠不要」讀 session 逐字稿，也「永遠不要」重做已經 commit 的工作 —— 並且把寫 handoff 當成「第一個動作」，這樣下一次中斷才不會一模一樣。⚠ 那份重建會吃掉新視窗的一塊，那就是你換掉的東西。⭐ 預設是 true，因為兩種失敗並不對稱：拒絕是「大聲的」，代價是一次檔案寫入；不拒絕是「安靜的」，代價是一整個視窗。 ⚠ 你「實際上」會在什麼時候看到這條拒絕：PACE。`brake_on_usage` 在預設值之下，STOP 時的派工「更早」就被用量煞車拒絕並返回了，根本走不到這個檢查 —— 所以條件裡 STOP 那一半只有在 `brake_on_usage: false` 時才到得了。⇒ 一份描述「讀者會遇到什麼」的文件，寫「從 PACE 開始」是對的；這則註解描述的是「程式碼測什麼」，那就必須兩種都涵蓋。它們是兩件不同的陳述，不是同一件事的兩份副本。
dispatch._auto_arm_resume: ARM THE RESUME AUTOMATICALLY once there is something worth resuming. Default true. ⭐ WHY: arming was the agent's job, and it is the one step whose omission cannot be recovered from - everything else leaves a trace to pick up later, but a run that ends with nothing armed simply never continues, and the handoff sits on disk while nothing reads it. ⚠ Arming is REVERSIBLE (`resume.py --cancel`, and the scheduled run stands down by itself when a session is alive); missing the moment is not. ⭐ WHEN IT FIRES: the verdict reads PACE or STOP, this dispatch names a task folder, and that folder holds a handoff that would actually be usable. It arms for THAT folder, never \"the newest task folder\", and against the reset of the window that is BLOCKING - which can be the seven-day one, days away. ⛔ IT ARMS ONCE. `resume.json` records the task and the reset it was armed for; the same pair does nothing. A DIFFERENT reset re-arms, because the blocking window really does change - the brake can flip from the five-hour window to the seven-day one, and a resume aimed at the old reset would wake still blocked. ⚠ A failure to arm never reaches the session: it is logged (AUTO-ARM-FAILED) and the dispatch proceeds. Set false to arm by hand only.
dispatch._auto_arm_resume_zh: 一旦有值得續跑的東西，就自動 arm 續跑。預設 true。⭐ 為什麼：arm 本來是 agent 的工作，而它是「唯一一個漏掉就救不回來」的步驟 —— 其他每件事都會留下痕跡可以之後撿回來，但一次「結束時什麼都沒 arm」的執行就是「永遠不會繼續」，handoff 躺在硬碟上而沒有任何東西會去讀它。⚠ arm 是「可逆的」（`resume.py --cancel`，而且有 session 活著時排程執行會自己讓路）；錯過那個時機則不可逆。⭐ 什麼時候觸發：判定讀到 PACE 或 STOP、這次派工指名了任務資料夾、而那個資料夾裡有一份「真的可用」的 handoff。它會 arm 給「那一個」資料夾，絕不是「最新的那個任務資料夾」，而且排在「正在擋住你的那個視窗」的重置時間 —— 那可能是七天視窗，好幾天以後。⛔ 只 arm 一次。`resume.json` 記著 arm 給哪個任務、排在哪個重置；同一組什麼都不做。「不同的重置」會重新 arm，因為擋住你的視窗真的會換 —— 煞車可能從五小時視窗翻成七天視窗，而一個瞄準舊重置的續跑醒來之後仍然是被擋住的。⚠ arm 失敗永遠不會打斷 session：它只記一行 log（AUTO-ARM-FAILED），派工照常進行。設 false 就只用手動 arm。
dispatch._model_price_hours: How old model_pricing.json may get, in HOURS, before the gate forks a background refresh from `model_price_url`. Default 24. ⚠ THE REFRESH NEVER BLOCKS ANYTHING: the session that notices the staleness keeps using the table it already has, and the new numbers land for the NEXT session. So a longer interval costs accuracy, never latency, and there is no reason to set it low. 0 or null pins the table to whatever is on disk. ⛔ A failed fetch is retried at most every 15 minutes, and the last attempt is recorded in model_pricing.status so a refresh that has been failing for a month cannot look like one that never needed to run - the session opening context says so.
dispatch._model_price_hours_zh: model_pricing.json 可以有多舊（小時），超過了 gate 就會 fork 一個背景程序去 `model_price_url` 更新。預設 24。⚠ 更新「永遠不會卡住任何事情」：發現資料舊了的那個 session 繼續用手上的表，新數字給「下一個」session 用。所以間隔拉長只損失準確度，不損失反應速度。設 0 或 null 就鎖在磁碟上那張表。⛔ 抓失敗最多 15 分鐘重試一次，而且最後一次結果會寫到 model_pricing.status，讓「抓了一個月都失敗」不會看起來像「本來就不需要抓」。
dispatch._model_price_update: ⛔ THE ONE SWITCH THAT STOPS THIS PLUGIN TALKING TO THE INTERNET. Before this feature it never did. Set false and nothing is ever fetched: the gate uses the seed table that ships in the repository, which is a real table taken from the published page on the day the release was cut. Everything still works - the ceiling is enforced, the skill and the prompt still carry the rule - the numbers simply stop moving.
dispatch._model_price_update_zh: ⛔ 這是「阻止這個外掛連網」的那個開關。這個功能之前，它從來不連網。設 false 就什麼都不抓：gate 會用隨儲存庫出貨的種子表，那是在切版本的那一天從官方頁面拿下來的真資料。其他一切照常：上限照樣執行，skill 和提示詞照樣帶規則 —— 只是數字不再變動。
dispatch._model_price_url: The page the table is parsed from. ⚠ It must be that page's MARKDOWN, not an HTML rendering of it - `.md` on the end of the docs URL is what serves it. Overridable so a mirror, a proxy, or a pinned copy can be used instead.
dispatch._model_price_url_zh: 價格表從哪一頁解析出來。⚠ 它必須是那一頁的「markdown」，不是 HTML 版—— 文件網址後面加 `.md` 就是。可以改成鏡像站、代理，或一份釘住的副本。
dispatch._require_dispatch_protocol: Must this session have INVOKED the `dispatch-protocol` skill before it may dispatch anything? Default true. ⭐ That skill is what this plugin IS: it says how a wave is planned, laid out on disk and paced, and every mechanical part of it is what the gate enforces - so a session dispatching without it is being refused by rules it never read. ⚠ The refusal REPEATS until the skill is loaded, unlike guard_unattended_first which nags once. It is defensible because the fix is always available to the agent: invoking a skill is a tool call it can make, and the SessionStart line names the skill before the first dispatch. ⛔ Residual risk, stated rather than hidden: if the skill registry itself is broken, that session cannot dispatch at all. This key is the escape hatch and it belongs to YOU - the refusal deliberately does not tell the agent to edit config, because a rule that names its own off switch is a rule that gets switched off. ⭐ And it cannot fail silently either: from the third refusal in one session the message names the other possibility, that this harness is not reporting `Skill` calls to the hook. A skill counts as loaded under any spelling - `dispatch-protocol`, `dispatch-guard:dispatch-protocol`, `apps/web:dispatch-protocol`.
dispatch._require_dispatch_protocol_zh: 這個 session 必須「已經叫過」`dispatch-protocol` skill 才可以派工嗎？預設 true。⭐ 那支 skill 就是這個外掛「本身」：它講一波派工怎麼規劃、怎麼落到硬碟、怎麼配速，而它每一個機械性的部分都是 gate 在強制的 —— 所以一個沒載入它就派工的 session，是在被「它從來沒讀過的規則」拒絕。⚠ 這個拒絕會「重複」直到 skill 載入，跟只唸一次的 guard_unattended_first 不同。這樣做站得住腳，是因為修法永遠在 agent 手上：叫一支 skill 就是一次它做得到的工具呼叫，而 SessionStart 那一行會在第一次派工之前就指名它。⛔ 殘餘風險講清楚不藏起來：如果 skill 註冊本身壞了，那個 session 就完全不能派工。這個鍵就是逃生口，而它屬於「你」—— 拒絕訊息刻意不告訴 agent 去改設定，因為一條會講出自己關閉開關的規則就是一條會被關掉的規則。⭐ 而且它也不會安靜地壞掉：同一個 session 的第三次拒絕開始，訊息會指出另一種可能，也就是這個 harness 沒有把 `Skill` 呼叫報給 hook。⭐ 一支 skill 不管用哪一種寫法都算載入了：`dispatch-protocol`、`dispatch-guard:dispatch-protocol`、`apps/web:dispatch-protocol`。
dispatch._require_unattended_work: Must `unattended-work` be loaded TOO before dispatching? Default FALSE. ⭐ Deliberately off: a skill exists to give an agent a WAY OF WORKING, not to gate it, and this plugin's job is dispatch discipline rather than unattended operation. Somebody dispatching sub-tasks while watching the screen needs dispatch-protocol and has no use for the review rounds, the stall test or the exit bar. Set true when nobody is watching and you want the two to travel together. ⚠ announce_unattended_work=false wins over this: that switch means "I do not want this skill", and refusing every dispatch until it loaded would be the plugin overruling its own off switch. ⚠ While this is false, guard_unattended_first still asks for the skill ONCE per session - a nag rather than a gate.
dispatch._require_unattended_work_zh: 派工之前也一定要載入 `unattended-work` 嗎？預設「false」。⭐ 刻意關閉：skill 存在的目的是給 agent 一套「做事的方式」，不是用來設閘門，而這個外掛的職責是派工紀律，不是無人職守。有人盯著螢幕派子任務的時候，他需要的是 dispatch-protocol，而審查輪次、停滯測試、收尾門檻對他沒有用。想讓兩支綁在一起（例如沒人看著的時候）就設成 true。⚠ announce_unattended_work=false 會贏過這個設定：那個開關的意思是「我不要這支 skill」，而為它拒絕每一次派工等於外掛推翻自己的關閉開關。⚠ 這個設成 false 的時候，guard_unattended_first 仍然會每個 session「唸一次」要你載入那支 skill —— 那是提醒，不是閘門。
dispatch._guards: -------- the silent-failure guards: commands where the wrong outcome and the right one look identical. Every one defaults to true, and every one has its own key on purpose - somebody will want the dispatch gate without the git gate. All of them fail OPEN: a guard that breaks is logged and skipped, never a blocked command.
dispatch._guards_zh: -------- 擋「安靜失敗」的守衛：做錯跟做對在螢幕上長得一模一樣的那種指令。每一條預設都是 true，而且每一條都刻意有自己的鍵 —— 有人會想要派工閘門但不要 git 閘門。全部都是「壞掉就放行」：守衛自己出錯會被記在 log 裡然後跳過，絕不會變成一個被擋住的指令。
dispatch._guard_commit_branch: Refuse a `git commit` when HEAD is on a branch this session did not select. The branch is recorded at SessionStart and re-recorded whenever this session itself runs checkout/switch/worktree add - so a branch you chose is always legitimate. It is a PER-COMMIT condition, not a per-session one: in a shared working tree another session can check out under you between two of your commits. Matched anywhere in a compound command, because the measured failure was `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git add -A && git commit …` - `&&` asks only whether the previous command SUCCEEDED, never whether its answer was ACCEPTABLE.
dispatch._guard_commit_branch_zh: HEAD 在一個「這個 session 沒有選過」的分支上時，拒絕 `git commit`。分支在 SessionStart 記下來，而且這個 session 自己跑 checkout/switch/worktree add 的時候會重新記 —— 所以你自己選的分支永遠是合法的。⭐ 這是「每次 commit」的條件，不是「每個 session」的條件：共用同一個工作目錄的時候，另一個 session 可以在你兩次 commit 之間把分支切走。⛔ 複合指令裡的任何位置都會被比對到，因為真實發生的那次失敗是 `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git add -A && git commit …` —— `&&` 只問前一個指令有沒有「成功」，從來不問它的答案「能不能接受」。
dispatch._guard_add_all: Refuse `git add -A`, `git add .` and `git add --all`. In a shared working tree those stage whatever every other session has been editing - that is how two unrelated files entered someone else's commit. Naming the paths you changed costs one flag. `git add ./one.py` is a named path and is allowed.
dispatch._guard_add_all_zh: 拒絕 `git add -A`、`git add .`、`git add --all`。共用工作目錄的時候，這幾個會把「其他每一個 session 正在改的東西」一起加進去 —— 兩個不相關的檔案就是這樣進了別人的 commit。按名字寫出你改的路徑只多打一點字。⭐ `git add ./one.py` 是具名路徑，放行。
dispatch._guard_commit_message_file: Refuse `git commit -m` (and `-am`) and name `-F <path>` instead. A message on the command line loses parentheses, backticks and `::` to the shell, and the damage is only visible in `git log` afterwards - when it is already history. `--amend` and `-F` are allowed.
dispatch._guard_commit_message_file_zh: 拒絕 `git commit -m`（以及 `-am`），並且指名改用 `-F <路徑>`。訊息寫在命令列上，括號、反引號、`::` 會被 shell 吃掉，而損害只有事後在 `git log` 裡看得到 —— 那時候它已經是歷史了。⭐ `--amend` 和 `-F` 放行。
dispatch._guard_silenced_search: Refuse a grep / rg / find / ls / git grep whose errors were thrown away: `2>/dev/null`, `2>$null`, `--no-messages`, or `-s` for grep. That flag is exactly what turns "you searched the wrong place" into "there is nothing there" - the two outputs are identical and only one of them is an answer. ⚠ `-s` is checked for grep ONLY: for ripgrep `-s` means --case-sensitive and silences nothing, and a guard that refuses correct commands is a guard you switch off.
dispatch._guard_silenced_search_zh: 把錯誤訊息丟掉的 grep / rg / find / ls / git grep 會被拒絕：`2>/dev/null`、`2>$null`、`--no-messages`、以及 grep 的 `-s`。⛔ 那個旗標正是把「你搜錯地方了」變成「那裡什麼都沒有」的東西 —— 兩種輸出一模一樣，而只有其中一種是答案。⚠ `-s` 只對 grep 檢查：ripgrep 的 `-s` 是 --case-sensitive，什麼都沒有靜音，而一條會拒絕正確指令的守衛就是一條你會關掉的守衛。
dispatch._guard_relative_cd: WARN (never refuse) on a chained command starting `cd <relative path>`. When the `cd` fails, every later command in the chain silently does not run and prints a clean-looking nothing. ⚠ It only warns because it cannot test the target: the shell's working directory persists between tool calls and the hook payload does not carry it, so the gate does not know what the path will resolve against. The warning reaches the agent, not the screen - `cd x && …` is ordinary, and a screen line on every routine correction teaches you to ignore the one channel a model cannot suppress.
dispatch._guard_relative_cd_zh: 以 `cd <相對路徑>` 開頭的串接指令會出「警告」，永遠不拒絕。`cd` 失敗的時候，後面每一個指令都安靜地不執行，然後印出一個看起來很乾淨的空結果。⚠ 只警告是因為它測不了那個目標：shell 的工作目錄在兩次工具呼叫之間會延續，而 hook payload 不帶那個值，所以 gate 不知道那個路徑會被解析到哪裡去。⭐ 警告只給 agent，不上螢幕 —— `cd x && …` 很日常，而每一次例行修正都跳一行螢幕訊息，只會訓練你忽略「模型唯一無法壓掉的那個管道」。
dispatch._guard_unattended_first: Refuse ONE dispatch when this session never invoked the `unattended-work` skill, then allow. Measured 2026-08-27: the SessionStart reminder naming that skill was ignored for an entire session and nothing noticed. ⚠ Once only - a skill that fails to load would otherwise deadlock the session at its first dispatch. ⛔ Silent when announce_unattended_work=false: refusing a dispatch for not loading a skill you opted out of would be the plugin overruling its own off switch.
dispatch._guard_unattended_first_zh: 這個 session 從來沒有叫過 `unattended-work` skill 的話，「拒絕一次」派工，然後就放行。2026-08-27 實測：SessionStart 那個指名這支 skill 的提醒，被整個 session 忽略，而且沒有任何東西注意到。⚠ 只拒絕一次 —— 否則一支載入失敗的 skill 會讓 session 在第一次派工就鎖死。⛔ announce_unattended_work=false 的時候完全安靜：為了「沒載入一支你已經選擇不要的 skill」而拒絕派工，等於外掛推翻自己的關閉開關。
dispatch._guard_unpushed: After a `git commit`, say so when the branch has unpushed commits OLDER than the one just made (`git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD` >= 2). Advisory only - PostToolUse cannot refuse anything. ⚠ A branch with no upstream is a NORMAL state, not an error, and stays silent.
dispatch._guard_unpushed_zh: `git commit` 之後，如果這個分支上還有「比剛剛那個更舊」的 commit 沒有推出去（`git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD` >= 2），就講出來。只是提醒 —— PostToolUse 沒有辦法拒絕任何東西。⚠ 一個還沒有 upstream 的分支是「正常狀態」不是錯誤，那種情況它保持安靜。
dispatch._guard_agent_report_file: Did the file a sub-task's prompt demanded actually appear? TWO HALVES, ONE SWITCH, and NEITHER EVER REFUSES - both are advisory. PostToolUse is the load-bearing half: the paths the prompt tells the agent to CREATE are worked out before the dispatch and stashed in its slot, and stat()ed when the agent returns; a missing one produces a note to the model and a line on your screen. It needs no knowledge of any agent's tool list, so it cannot go stale, and it catches an agent that COULD write and simply did not. PreToolUse adds a cheap early warning when a read-only subagent_type is paired with a prompt telling it to create a file - from a dated snapshot of the built-in read-only types plus the `tools:` line of `.claude/agents/<name>.md`, and an UNKNOWN type says nothing at all. Measured 2026-08-31: a round-2 ADR review dispatched as `Explore` could not create its report, returned the whole review as its final message, and its verification table and five findings were permanently lost in a turn the dispatcher never received. The prompt-reading is a deliberately conservative regex - a whole-word creation verb, then a `.md` path within 200 characters, the reach stopping at the end of the sentence or after one line break, whichever comes first; a bare filename resolves against the dispatch's own task folder. Measured against this repository's 18 real work orders: 19 paths, every one a genuine report file, no false positives. A phrasing it does not recognise is missed, which costs nothing, rather than invented, which would get the guard switched off.
dispatch._guard_agent_report_file_zh: 子任務的提示詞要求的檔案，實際上有沒有出現？⭐ 兩半、一個開關，而且「兩半都不會拒絕」，都只是提醒。PostToolUse 那一半是真正守得住的：提示詞叫 agent 「建立」的路徑會在派工之前算好、存進它的 slot，agent 回來時再 stat 一次；少了就對模型送一段說明，並且在你的畫面上印一行。⭐ 它不需要知道任何 agent 的工具清單，所以不會過期，而且它抓得到「有能力寫但就是沒寫」的情況。PreToolUse 那一半是便宜的提前警告：唯讀的 subagent_type 配上一份叫它建立檔案的提示詞就警告 —— 判斷來自一份有日期的內建唯讀型別快照，加上 `.claude/agents/<name>.md` 的 `tools:` 那一行，而⛔「不認識的型別什麼都不說」。實測 2026-08-31：一次 ADR 第二輪審查被派成 `Explore`，建不出報告檔，把整份審查當成最後一則訊息回傳，而它的驗證表格和五項發現在派工端從來沒收到的中間回合裡永久遺失。⚠ 讀提示詞用的是「刻意保守」的正規表示式 —— 先有一個「完整字」的建立動詞，後面 200 字元內接一個 `.md` 路徑，而且這個範圍在「句子結束」或「跨過一個換行」兩者先到的地方就停；只寫檔名不寫路徑的話，會用這次派工自己的任務資料夾去解。⭐ 拿這個 repo 自己的 18 份工作單實測：抓到 19 個路徑，每一個都是真正的報告檔，零誤報。它認不出來的寫法會被漏掉（不花任何代價），而不是被它自己編出來（那會讓人把這個 guard 關掉）。

_idle_after_min: `--watch` only. Minutes with NO SIGN OF ANYBODY WORKING before the watcher STOPS asking the API. ⛔ TWO SOURCES SINCE 0.47.0, WHICHEVER IS NEWER, and the second one is not this plugin's: the gate's own state/*.alive files, AND the mtime of ~/.claude.json, which Claude Code writes whether or not any hook of ours is wired. Why: when the plugin's hooks are not wired up - a deleted install directory, an interrupted update - the first signal goes flat while somebody is working, and the watcher read that as "gone home". MEASURED 2026-08-30: .alive frozen at 1225 minutes on a machine in continuous use, the watcher asleep 20 hours, and `install.py --status` reporting everything live. During the 22 minutes before the hooks were repaired, ~/.claude.json was written nine times and never got older than 3.71 minutes. ⚠ When the two DISAGREE the watcher shows `HOOK?` beside the clock - somebody is working and our hooks are silent; `/plugin update` or a reinstall plus a restart is the repair. ⭐ Point the second source elsewhere with $CLAUDE_USER_CONFIG, or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. The VS Code task is bound to the folder being open, not to a session being alive, so without this it polls all night against an endpoint that allows about five calls per access token. It never stops REDRAWING - the line keeps updating and says there is no activity and how old the figure is, because silently showing a stale number as a current one is the confident wrong answer this plugin refuses everywhere else. A heartbeat resumes the normal cadence with ONE call, never a catch-up burst. 0 or negative switches the pause off. ⛔ --statusline is NOT gated this way: it is only ever invoked because a session is interacting.
_idle_after_min_zh: 只影響 `--watch`。超過這麼多分鐘「沒有任何人在工作的跡象」，watcher 就停止向 API 要數字。⛔ 0.47.0 起有「兩個來源，取比較新的那個」，而且第二個不是這個外掛的檔案：gate 自己的 state/*.alive，以及 ~/.claude.json 的修改時間 —— 那個檔案是 Claude Code 自己寫的，不管我們的 hook 有沒有掛上。⚠ 為什麼要這樣：當外掛的 hook 沒掛上時（安裝目錄被刪、更新中斷），第一個訊號會在你還在工作的時候「變平」，而 watcher 會把那個平讀成「人走了」。實測 2026-08-30：.alive 卡在 1225 分鐘，機器一直在用，watcher 睡了 20 小時，而 `install.py --status` 全程回報一切正常。在 hook 被修好之前那 22 分鐘裡，~/.claude.json 被寫了九次，年齡從沒超過 3.71 分鐘。⭐ 兩個來源「不一致」的時候，watcher 會在時鐘旁邊顯示 `HOOK?` —— 有人在工作，但我們的 hook 沒在跑；修法是 `/plugin update` 或重裝再重開。⭐ 想指到別的檔案：$CLAUDE_USER_CONFIG，或 $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR。那個 VS Code 工作綁在「資料夾有沒有開著」，不是綁在「有沒有 session 活著」，所以少了這個設定它會整晚打一個大約每 token 只允許五次呼叫的端點。⭐ 它不會停止重畫：那一行照樣更新，並且說明現在沒有活動、以及手上這個數字多舊了 —— 安靜地把過期數字當成現在的數字，正是這個外掛到處都在拒絕的那種「有自信的錯答案」。⭐ 有心跳回來就立刻恢復正常節奏，而且只花一次呼叫，不會補打一串。設 0 或負數就關掉這個暫停。⛔ `--statusline` 不受此限：它會被呼叫，本來就是因為有 session 正在互動。
_color: COMPATIBILITY ONLY. 'color' is accepted as a spelling alias for 'colour'. If both appear, 'colour' wins.
_color_zh: 「僅為相容」。'color' 被接受為 'colour' 的拼法別名。兩個都出現的話，'colour' 贏。
_guard: COMPATIBILITY ONLY. The threshold keys above may instead be nested under a 'guard' object, which is where claude-pacer kept them. Top level is preferred; both are read, and the nested one wins.
_guard_zh: 「僅為相容」。上面那些門檻鍵也可以改成放在一個 'guard' 物件底下，那是 claude-pacer 放它們的地方。優先用最上層；兩邊都會被讀，而嵌套的那個會贏。
